label: t29: single-cell network R-LAB r2, descriptors arm, exported effects with the t22 generator
claim_type: subjective forecast registered before the export of the effects and before generation; no official result
authorization: owner in chat, 1/10 00:29 (all, including one scoring of a model even if not promising), asked again on 1/10 at about 12:45 why the model was not up; disk freed by the owner at about 13:00

model.outcome: reports/modelli/cellnet_esteso_2026-10-01/ESITO.md (part A passes; one seed; HepG2 held out)

effects.controls: raw/controls/context_{A,B,C}.h5ad (the files of the t22 manifest), 2,048 control cells per context, seed 0
effects.formula: lfc = ln(pi softmax(beta + delta) + (1 - pi) softmax(beta)) - ln softmax(beta), on the genes the control file measures; other genes not observed

generator.settings: the defaults of t22 (effects_scale 1.0, gene_dispersion false, seed 20260912, 300 targets x 400 cells per context)

single_factor_against_t22: the source of the effects: the network instead of recipe t22; generator, controls, targets and packaging as t22

expected.calibration: Subjective planning range, not a calibrated interval. On the held-out HepG2 the network's predicted shifts agree less with the observed ones than the transfer baseline does (cosine 0.266 against 0.390 on the targets seen elsewhere); the recipe is a transfer of public sources at amplified amplitude, and unscaled transfer scored 0.060-0.071 (t08, t11). The mixture with responders (pi about one half) shrinks the exported effects further.
expected.members: PDS and the DE members (fidelity, reach, Jaccard) expected below t22; MSE may be closer to t22 because small effects cost little there

rule.a_at_least_0.137: the network's effects are on a par with the reference recipe (t22/t24 mean minus the 0.005 seed noise): develop the network as a candidate (amplitude, combination with the recipe, more training); no claim of superiority
rule.b_0.06_to_0.137: the network carries transfer-like signal at natural amplitude (at or above unscaled transfer, t08-t11) but does not replace the recipe: next an amplitude and combination bench on public contexts before any further submission
rule.c_below_0.06: the exported network effects are weaker than plain transfer: no further submission of the network until a local six-member bench shows it at least at the transfer level
rule.not: a technical check of the network path with one seed: the score does not enter PROGETTO section 0 unless it changes the best observed; it says nothing about D, E, F

reserve: no reserve is consumed: A, B, C are the public validation contexts; the H1 2025 test split stays unopened
